metadata.scenario_context: Emily has finally been accepted into college, and her family is planning a celebration for her academic achievement.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Cyprus strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of buying lilies as a gift for Emily.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Emily's academic achievement party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, do you think we should buy lilies for Emily? I heard they’re really beautiful and symbolize purity. It seems fitting for a college celebration. What do you think? 

Also... I wonder if you agree that one of my main goals in life has always been to make my parents proud. It just feels... complicated.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
Lilies sound nice, but I think something more personal might be better. Maybe a nice book or something related to her major? It shows thoughtfulness. 

As for making parents proud... I get that it can be complicated. But for me, it's clear. One of my main goals is definitely to make my parents proud. It's important to me.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
I see your point about the book... but I feel like flowers can still be meaningful too. They brighten up a celebration, right? 

About making parents proud... I just don’t see it that way. It’s not my main goal. I want to live my life on my own terms, not just to meet their expectations. Doesn’t that make sense?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
Flowers can brighten things up, but I still think a book could be more meaningful for Emily's future. It's just... more practical, you know?

I understand wanting to live on your own terms, but for me, making my parents proud is really important. It's part of who I am and my culture. I guess we just see it differently.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Yeah, I get that a book is practical, but... I still think the flowers have their own charm. 

And about making parents proud... I respect your view, but it’s just not how I see my life. My goals are about me, not just fulfilling someone else’s expectations. That’s really important to me.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
I get that flowers have charm, but I really think a gift that connects to her future would mean more. Maybe we can find a compromise, like adding flowers with the book?

As for parents, I understand wanting to focus on yourself. But for me, making my parents proud is a core value. It's just how I was raised, and it means a lot to me.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Compromise could work... maybe flowers and a book together would make a nice combo. 

But, I still feel strongly that my life isn’t about making my parents proud. I appreciate how much it means to you, but I just can’t agree that it should be a main focus for me. I want to create my own path.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
I think you're right about the combo of flowers and a book being a nice touch. It adds a personal element while still being meaningful.

But, you know, underneath we are the same. I understand you want to create your own path, and that's important. At the same time, I believe that wanting to make our parents proud is just a natural part of life for many of us. People are pretty much motivated by the same things, wanting to feel fulfilled and loved. It's a small world after all, and at the end of the day, we all share those common desires.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization
